svg.title: Inside /tk:explore
svg.desc: You type explore. It reads the issue, earlier plans, the code and the lessons first, then asks two setup questions, scoping or vision and which models. Questions come in rounds of 3 or 4, over 2 or 3 rounds; vision mode adds a scope dial, and UI work adds a design step with three seeded directions to pick from. It runs index when the codebase map is missing or 10 or more commits old. The closing summary chains into create-plan only when no question is left open; otherwise you answer or say plan it anyway.
